question: Who is eligible for the Ladli Behna Yojana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Women above 21 years of age**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana** is a flagship social welfare scheme launched by the **Government of Madhya Pradesh** to empower women financially and improve their health and nutrition levels.
 
• As per the revised eligibility criteria, women belonging to the **age group of 21 to 60 years** are eligible to apply for the scheme. Initially, the minimum age was set at **23 years**, but it was later reduced to **21 years** to include more beneficiaries. ***Hence, the statement regarding women above 21 years is correct.***
 
• To be eligible, the applicant must be a **permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh**. This ensures that the state's resources are utilized for its own citizens.
 
• The scheme targets women from economically weaker sections. The annual **family income** of the applicant must not exceed **₹2.5 lakh**.
 
• Women who are **married, widowed, divorced, or deserted** are eligible for the benefits. This inclusive approach ensures that vulnerable women in various social situations are covered.
 
• Exclusion criteria include households where any member is an **income tax payer** or holds a **permanent government job** (Central or State government). ***Hence, the option regarding women in government jobs is incorrect.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Launch Details:** The scheme was officially launched on **March 5, 2023**, by the then Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh, **Shivraj Singh Chouhan**. It was introduced to mark a significant step toward women's **financial independence**.
 
• **Financial Assistance:** Under this scheme, the government initially provided **₹1,000 per month** to every eligible woman. The amount was subsequently increased to **₹1,250 per month** starting from **October 2023**.
 
• **Mode of Payment:** The financial aid is transferred directly into the **Aadhaar-linked bank accounts** of the beneficiaries through the **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)** system to ensure transparency and prevent leakage.
 
• **Social Impact:** The scheme aims to improve the **decision-making power** of women within their families and encourages them to spend on their **health, nutrition, and education** of their children.
 
• **Implementation:** The **Women and Child Development Department** of Madhya Pradesh is the nodal agency responsible for the execution and monitoring of the scheme.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Required Documentation:** To register for the scheme, applicants typically need their **Samagra ID**, **Aadhaar Card**, and a **bank account** that is **e-KYC** compliant and linked with **Aadhaar**.
 
• **Application Process:** Registration is conducted through organized **camps** at the **Gram Panchayat** or **Ward level**. No fee is charged for the application process, making it accessible to the rural and urban poor.
 
• **Land Ownership Limit:** Households owning more than **5 acres of agricultural land** are generally excluded from the scheme, focusing the benefits on small-scale farmers and landless laborers.
 
• **Vehicle Ownership:** Families owning a **four-wheeler** (excluding tractors used for farming) are also ineligible for the benefits under the current guidelines.
 
• **Recent Statistics:** As of late **2023**, more than **1.25 crore women** in Madhya Pradesh have been registered as beneficiaries under this transformative scheme.

47:T
